Speaker: A
Text: You forgot our anniversary again, didn't you?

Speaker: B
Text: I had a massive deadline at work today, I'm sorry.

Speaker: A
Text: Work is always your excuse. I'm tired of being second place.

Speaker: B
Text: That's not fair. I am trying to build a future for us.

Speaker: A
Text: A future means nothing if you aren't present in the baseline relationship.

Speaker: B
Text: I don't know how to make you happy anymore.

Speaker: A
Text: Are you going out with your friends again tonight?

Speaker: B
Text: Yeah, Mark invited me out. Do you want to come?

Speaker: A
Text: No, it's fine. You should go have fun.

Speaker: B
Text: Are you sure? You seem a bit distant.

Speaker: A
Text: I'm completely fine. Just tired from the week.

Speaker: B
Text: Okay, well, let me know if you need anything.

Speaker: A
Text: I'm so nervous about this job interview tomorrow.

Speaker: B
Text: You are going to crush it. You've prepared so hard.

Speaker: A
Text: What if they ask something I don't know?

Speaker: B
Text: Then you'll be honest and smart about it. I believe in you entirely.

Speaker: A
Text: Thank you for always being my biggest rock.

Speaker: B
Text: Always. Let's celebrate after you finish.

Speaker: A
Text: I received the job offer in Chicago today.

Speaker: B
Text: Wow. That's a huge opportunity for your career.

Speaker: A
Text: It is, but it means moving across the country.

Speaker: B
Text: We always said we'd figure things out when they happen.

Speaker: A
Text: Does 'figuring it out' mean you coming with me?

Speaker: B
Text: I love my job here, A. It's a lot to think about.

Speaker: A
Text: Look at the stars tonight, it's incredibly clear.

Speaker: B
Text: They're beautiful, but I'd rather look at you.

Speaker: A
Text: That was incredibly cheesy, you know.

Speaker: B
Text: Maybe, but I mean every single word of it.

Speaker: A
Text: I love you so much, B.

Speaker: B
Text: I love you more.

Speaker: A
Text: We haven't sat down for dinner together all week.

Speaker: B
Text: Schedules have just been chaotic, it's nothing personal.

Speaker: A
Text: I know, it just feels like we're roommates lately.

Speaker: B
Text: We're just in a busy season. It'll pass soon.

Speaker: A
Text: I hope so. I miss how things used to be.

Speaker: B
Text: Things change, A. It doesn't mean it's bad.

Speaker: A
Text: Who was texting you so late last night?

Speaker: B
Text: Just a coworker about the project timeline.

Speaker: A
Text: Since when do coworkers text you emojis at midnight?

Speaker: B
Text: Are you seriously interrogating me right now?

Speaker: A
Text: If you have nothing to hide, show me the thread.

Speaker: B
Text: No, because you don't trust me, and that's the real issue.

Speaker: A
Text: Did you see the credit card statement this month?

Speaker: B
Text: Yes, I had to fix the car brakes. It was urgent.

Speaker: A
Text: We agreed to consult each other for anything over two hundred.

Speaker: B
Text: I was stranded on the highway, A! What should I have done?

Speaker: A
Text: A quick phone call would have sufficed.

Speaker: B
Text: Fine. Next time I'll just sit on the shoulder and wait.

Speaker: A
Text: The adoption agency just approved our application!

Speaker: B
Text: Oh my god, really?! This is happening!

Speaker: A
Text: Yes! We are officially going to be parents!

Speaker: B
Text: I'm crying, I can't believe our dream is finally real.

Speaker: A
Text: We're going to be great at this together.

Speaker: B
Text: The absolute best team ever.

Speaker: A
Text: You let Leo stay up past his bedtime again.

Speaker: B
Text: He was right in the middle of reading his book.

Speaker: A
Text: Consistency is important for his development, B.

Speaker: B
Text: A little bit of flexibility won't hurt him either.

Speaker: A
Text: It hurts our routine when I have to deal with the tantrums.

Speaker: B
Text: I'll handle him tomorrow morning then.

Speaker: A
Text: I am so incredibly sorry for what I said during the fight.

Speaker: B
Text: It really hurt me, A. It crossed a major line.

Speaker: A
Text: I know. I lost my temper and it was completely inexcusable.

Speaker: B
Text: Thank you for acknowledging that. It means a lot.

Speaker: A
Text: Can we work through this? I want to make it right.

Speaker: B
Text: Yes, we can. Come here.

Speaker: A
Text: My mother wants to stay with us for three weeks.

Speaker: B
Text: Three weeks is a long time for our small apartment.

Speaker: A
Text: She lives alone and really misses us.

Speaker: B
Text: I understand, but my work is incredibly stressful right now.

Speaker: A
Text: So her presence is a burden to you?

Speaker: B
Text: I didn't say that. I just value our personal space.

Speaker: A
Text: Did you forget to take out the trash again?

Speaker: B
Text: I've been working a twelve-hour shift, cut me some slack.

Speaker: A
Text: It takes literally thirty seconds to do.

Speaker: B
Text: If it's so quick, why don't you just do it yourself?

Speaker: A
Text: Because we live here together and split chores!

Speaker: B
Text: Well right now I'm exhausted, so it's staying there.

Speaker: A
Text: Do you think we'll ever get married?

Speaker: B
Text: We're happy right now, isn't that what matters?

Speaker: A
Text: It matters, but I want a sense of commitment and security.

Speaker: B
Text: A piece of paper doesn't guarantee security, A.

Speaker: A
Text: It's not just paper to me. It's a statement.

Speaker: B
Text: Let's just focus on enjoying our time together today.

Speaker: A
Text: I feel really overwhelmed handling the house cleaning alone.

Speaker: B
Text: I'm so sorry. I didn't realize how much fell on you.

Speaker: A
Text: Thank you for listening. I just need a bit of help.

Speaker: B
Text: Let's set up a weekly schedule right now so it's fair.

Speaker: A
Text: That would honestly make me feel so much better.

Speaker: B
Text: I'm on it. We're partners in everything.

Speaker: A
Text: Oh, you bought the generic brand of coffee.

Speaker: B
Text: It was on sale. Is it a problem?

Speaker: A
Text: No, it's fine. If you like cheap coffee, that's fine.

Speaker: B
Text: You can drink something else if you hate it so much.

Speaker: A
Text: I didn't say I hated it. I just noticed, that's all.

Speaker: B
Text: Right. Message received.

Speaker: A
Text: Do you still find me attractive after all these years?

Speaker: B
Text: More than the day I met you, without a doubt.

Speaker: A
Text: My body has changed so much since having kids.

Speaker: B
Text: Every change reminds me of the beautiful family we built.

Speaker: A
Text: You always know exactly what to say to comfort me.

Speaker: B
Text: Because it's the absolute truth. You're stunning.

Speaker: A
Text: I want to start saving up to buy a house.

Speaker: B
Text: I was thinking we should travel Europe next summer instead.

Speaker: A
Text: Europe is temporary, a house is an asset for our life.

Speaker: B
Text: We're only young once, A. Houses can wait.

Speaker: A
Text: I feel like our timelines just aren't matching up.

Speaker: B
Text: We just have different priorities right now, it's fine.

Speaker: A
Text: Can you please try to be on time for once?

Speaker: B
Text: Can you please get off my back for once?

Speaker: A
Text: It's disrespectful to keep everyone waiting for you.

Speaker: B
Text: Maybe I just don't care about your boring work events.

Speaker: A
Text: You don't care about anything that isn't about you.

Speaker: B
Text: Bingo. Glad you finally figured it out.

Speaker: A
Text: What are you thinking about right now?

Speaker: B
Text: Nothing really, just tired.

Speaker: A
Text: You've been staring at the wall for ten minutes.

Speaker: B
Text: Just spacing out. Don't read too much into it.

Speaker: A
Text: I wish you would share your internal world with me more.

Speaker: B
Text: There's nothing to share. I'm just empty right now.

Speaker: A
Text: I made your favorite pancakes for breakfast today.

Speaker: B
Text: Wow, what did I do to deserve you?

Speaker: A
Text: Just being you is more than enough.

Speaker: B
Text: You make every morning feel like a holiday.

Speaker: A
Text: Eat up before they get cold!

Speaker: B
Text: Thank you, sweetheart.

Speaker: A
Text: Do you want to watch a movie tonight?

Speaker: B
Text: Sure, as long as I can finish this email first.

Speaker: A
Text: You're always on your laptop when we watch things.

Speaker: B
Text: I'm still sitting right next to you though.

Speaker: A
Text: Being in the same room isn't the same as being together.

Speaker: B
Text: I'm multitasking so I can free up my weekend.

Speaker: A
Text: I don't think I love you anymore, B.

Speaker: B
Text: Please don't say that. We can fix this.

Speaker: A
Text: We've been trying to fix this for three years.

Speaker: B
Text: I can change, I will do anything it takes.

Speaker: A
Text: The spark is completely gone. Trying just hurts more.

Speaker: B
Text: My heart is completely breaking right now.

Speaker: A
Text: Why did you lock your phone when I walked in?

Speaker: B
Text: No reason, just closing an app.

Speaker: A
Text: You've been very protective of it lately.

Speaker: B
Text: You're acting paranoid. It's just a phone.

Speaker: A
Text: I never used to feel unsafe sharing things with you.

Speaker: B
Text: You are creating a problem out of absolutely nothing.

Speaker: A
Text: Thank you for taking care of me while I was sick.

Speaker: B
Text: Of course. There's nowhere else I'd rather be.

Speaker: A
Text: The soup was amazing, and the house is spotless.

Speaker: B
Text: Your only job right now is to rest and recover.

Speaker: A
Text: I am incredibly lucky to have you as my partner.

Speaker: B
Text: I'm the lucky one. Rest up.

Speaker: A
Text: So we're spending Thanksgiving with your parents?

Speaker: B
Text: Yes, and Christmas with yours. Like we agreed.

Speaker: A
Text: I know, it's just your parents' place is so chaotic.

Speaker: B
Text: It's only for four days, A. We can survive it.

Speaker: A
Text: I'll try my best to keep a smile on my face.

Speaker: B
Text: I appreciate you doing this for me.

Speaker: A
Text: What do you want to do this weekend?

Speaker: B
Text: I don't know, same old stuff I guess.

Speaker: A
Text: We do the exact same routine every single week.

Speaker: B
Text: Routine is comfortable. I like comfortable.

Speaker: A
Text: It feels incredibly stagnant to me, like a trap.

Speaker: B
Text: If you're bored, find a hobby.

Speaker: A
Text: You didn't kiss me goodbye this morning.

Speaker: B
Text: I was running late for my train, sorry.

Speaker: A
Text: It feels like those small physical connections are dropping off.

Speaker: B
Text: I was literally sprinting out the door, A.

Speaker: A
Text: It's not just today. It's a pattern.

Speaker: B
Text: I think you're overanalyzing a hectic morning.

Speaker: A
Text: The budget is going to be tight this month due to the move.

Speaker: B
Text: We can cut back on eating out and cancel a few apps.

Speaker: A
Text: I'll pack lunches for work to save extra cash.

Speaker: B
Text: Perfect. Together we can handle this easily.

Speaker: A
Text: We always find a way to make it work.

Speaker: B
Text: Because we're in this together, 100%.

Speaker: A
Text: I saw your ex liked your photo online today.

Speaker: B
Text: Oh, did she? We're on civil terms, it's harmless.

Speaker: A
Text: I thought you cut off contact after the breakup.

Speaker: B
Text: An occasional double tap isn't 'keeping contact'.

Speaker: A
Text: It still makes me feel slightly uncomfortable.

Speaker: B
Text: I can't control what other people click on, A.
